moments.title: GB Swimmers Strike Gold in Paris
moments.blurb: Great Britain's Katie Shanahan and Angharad Evans secured gold medals at the European Aquatics Championships in Paris today, with Shanahan setting a British record and Evans a Championship record.

angles.name: Breaking News - Gold Medals
angles.copy: GOLD! 🥇 Huge congratulations to Katie Shanahan and Angharad Evans for their incredible performances at the European Aquatics Championships in Paris. Shanahan set a British record, and Evans a Championship record! What a day for Team GB!

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: British Record for Katie Shanahan, Championship Record for Angharad Evans! Our GB swimmers are absolutely smashing it in Paris. Who else is buzzing from these gold medal wins?

moments.title: Keely Hodgkinson Eyes European Gold
moments.blurb: British star Keely Hodgkinson won her 800m semi-final today at the European Athletics Championships, targeting a third consecutive title, amidst reports her coaches were removed from their seats.

angles.name: Hodgkinson in Final
angles.copy: Keely Hodgkinson is through to the 800m final at the European Athletics Championships! Can she make it three golds in a row? We're rooting for her! #EuroAthletics

angles.name: Coaches Drama
angles.copy: Drama at the European Athletics Champs! Keely Hodgkinson's coaches reportedly removed from their seats ahead of her semi-final win. What was going on?!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh Fringe Festival, the world's largest arts festival, is in full swing until August 31, with thousands of shows across theatre, comedy, dance, and music captivating audiences.

angles.name: Fringe is ON
angles.copy: Edinburgh Fringe is buzzing! From comedy to cabaret, music to theatre, what shows are you catching this week? The festival runs until August 31st!

angles.name: Scottish Spotlight
angles.copy: Scotland is the place to be! The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is delivering an incredible array of talent. If you're there this week, soak it all in!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 20th non-consecutive week, making it the longest-running UK No.1 single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: 20 WEEKS AT NUMBER ONE! 👑 Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its historic run, now officially the longest-running UK No.1 single EVER. What a track!

angles.name: New Chart Entries
angles.copy: Beyond the record-breaking 'Rein Me In', Ariana Grande is making waves with new entries 'Petal' and 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' on the Official UK Singles Chart. What's your favourite new tune?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off on Saturday, August 22, with Arsenal v Coventry City being the first televised match on Friday 21st August.

angles.name: Football's Back!
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! ⚽ The Premier League returns next weekend, Saturday August 22nd. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: First Match Buzz
angles.copy: Only 8 days until Premier League football returns! Arsenal vs Coventry City kicks off the action next Friday. Ready for the new season?

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Continues in London
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents festival series at Crystal Palace Bowl in London continues until August 16, featuring a diverse lineup including Bastille and The Wombats.

angles.name: London Gigs
angles.copy: Still time to catch some amazing acts at Palace Bowl Presents! Bastille & The Wombats are playing this weekend at Crystal Palace Bowl. Who's going?

angles.name: Weekend Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The sun is out and the music's on! Palace Bowl Presents runs until Sunday – perfect for some last-minute summer festival vibes in London.

moments.title: Happy 42nd Birthday James Morrison
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for hits like 'You Give Me Something' and 'Broken Strings', turns 42 today.

angles.name: James Morrison turns 42
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday to the incredible James Morrison! His soulful voice and timeless tracks like 'You Give Me Something' still sound amazing.

angles.name: Soulful Sounds
angles.copy: It's James Morrison's birthday! What's your favourite track from the Brit Award winner? We're cranking up 'Broken Strings' today.

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday Feargal Sharkey
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, the iconic Irish singer best known as the frontman of The Undertones and for his solo hit 'A Good Heart', celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Feargal Sharkey 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the distinctive voice of Feargal Sharkey! From The Undertones to 'A Good Heart', his music is pure gold. What's your favourite?

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Rewind to the 80s for Feargal Sharkey's birthday! Still love 'A Good Heart' – a true classic. Happy 67th!

moments.title: Happy 27th Birthday Lennon Stella
moments.blurb: Canadian singer and actress Lennon Stella, known for her role in 'Nashville' and her soulful pop music, turns 27 today.

angles.name: Lennon Stella 27
angles.copy: Happy 27th Birthday to the talented Lennon Stella! From 'Nashville' to her stunning pop tracks, she's a star. What's your top Lennon Stella song?

moments.title: Happy 37th Birthday MØ
moments.blurb: Danish singer-songwriter MØ, globally recognised for her collaborations and solo hits like 'Lean On', celebrates her 37th birthday today.

angles.name: MØ turns 37
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to the brilliant Danish artist MØ! 'Lean On' is still an absolute banger. What's your favourite MØ track?

moments.title: Happy 32nd Birthday Phoebe Bridgers
moments.blurb: American indie pop singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers, known for her critically acclaimed albums, will celebrate her 32nd birthday on August 17.

angles.name: Phoebe Bridgers 32
angles.copy: Get ready to wish Phoebe Bridgers a Happy 32nd Birthday on Monday! What's your go-to song from the indie queen?

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead vocalist of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist with hits like 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth', turns 68 on August 17.

angles.name: Belinda Carlisle 68
angles.copy: On Monday, we celebrate the amazing Belinda Carlisle's 68th Birthday! 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' still gives us chills. What's your favourite Go-Go's or solo track?

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday Kelvin Mercer (Posdnuos)
moments.blurb: Kelvin Mercer, also known as Posdnuos from the legendary hip-hop group De La Soul, celebrates his 57th birthday on August 17.

angles.name: De La Soul Legend
angles.copy: Massive Happy 57th Birthday wishes to Kelvin Mercer, aka Posdnuos from the iconic De La Soul, this Monday! His flow is legendary.

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: Most schools across England and Wales are still enjoying their summer holidays, with many returning around September 1st, while Scottish schools returned earlier this week.

angles.name: Summer Vibes
angles.copy: Still soaking up those summer holiday vibes across the UK! How are you spending these last few weeks before the back-to-school rush?

angles.name: Scottish Schools Back
angles.copy: While many UK schools are still off, a big welcome back to all the students in Scotland who returned this week! How was the first day back?
